artworks.title: Ha! La joli petit chien
artworks.description: The image shows two women in an indoor setting. The woman on the left is seated, looking up at the other woman. She wears a dress with a floral embellishment and lace details. The woman on the right stands with her back partly to the viewer, engaged in conversation. She wears a dress with lace accents and an elaborate bonnet, holding a small dog. The background includes a curtain, a mantle shelf with a lantern and a candleholder, and a wall with floral detailing. The floor has a patterned design.

artworks.title: Le petit conseil
artworks.description: The image shows two women, one seated and the other standing. The standing woman is depicted from head to toe and is leaning against a small wooden table. She has features, a light complexion, and curly hair partially covered by a lace cap. She wears a long dress with a white shawl around her shoulders and a pink sash around her waist. Beside her on the table, there is a small book or pamphlet, and on the table behind her, there is a pitcher and a basin. The seated woman, shown from head to knees, is positioned in profile, looking up at the standing woman while resting her elbow on the table. She has curly hair and is also dressed in a long gown in hues of green and orange, with a light shawl similar to the standing woman's. The chair she sits on is ornate, and there is a footstool beside her. The background features a curtain and a patterned rug on the floor.

artworks.title: La jeune vestale
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet after Jean-Jacques-François Le Barbier I
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a woman in a classical styled portrait. She is depicted in a side profile, turned slightly towards the viewer, with her head angled downward as she appears to place flowers onto a smoking incense burner. Her facial features include soft, delicate expressions with closed lips and a calm demeanor. She has long hair that appears to be tucked beneath a veil. Adorning her head is a floral crown, featuring blooms of pink and red. Her clothing is draped in a loose, classical style, likely a gown, with her arms slightly exposed as she leans forward towards the burner. Around her waist, the fabric is gathered, creating a flowing effect. The background of the image is a deep, muted tone, with billowing smoke rising from the burner behind her, creating a dramatic effect against the otherwise plain backdrop.

artworks.title: La Venus aux colombes
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet after Jean-Jacques-François Le Barbier I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman sitting and holding white doves. She has delicate facial features, a serene expression, and is wearing a draped garment. The background is neutral.

artworks.title: The Harvesters' Lunch
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet after Pierre Alexandre Wille
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner with roulette work
artworks.description: The image shows a gathering of people in a rural setting. A high haystack with a ladder leaning against it is central. There are delicately precise brushstrokes depicting textures and expressions. The color palette includes earthy tones, blues, and greens, creating a serene atmosphere. Various objects like baskets and kettles are scattered. Trees with lush foliage frame the scene. In the distance, a figure tends to a horse-drawn cart. The composition conveys movement and interaction, capturing a communal moment.

artworks.title: Les Nourrices (The Nurses)

sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 28.4 × 20.3 cm (11 3/16 × 8 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays four individuals in varying poses. One person is standing in profile, holding a baby, dressed in a long garment and headscarf. Another person is seated, also holding a baby, wearing similar attire. Two others are partially visible, one seated or reclining with a headscarf, and the other peering from behind the standing figure. The background is rustic, with a ladder against a rough wall and indistinct structures. The illustration is in earthy tones, with the title "Les Nourrices" at the bottom.

artworks.title: L'Oiseau privé
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet after Jean Jacques Lagrenée II
artworks.description: The image shows a group of four people gathered indoors. Three full figures are in view, while one woman on the right is partially obscured behind another woman. The man, seated on the right, is slightly bent forward, holding a hat in his hands, with a small animal at his feet. He has short brown hair. His clothing includes a red jacket, a vest, and darker trousers. Two women and a child are positioned to his left. The woman closest to him has a headscarf and leans forward, resting her arm on a chair back and clasping her hand with the other woman, who is leaning over her shoulder. Both women are wearing white dresses and have a similar hairstyle with a head wrap or bonnet. The child, partially hidden, peeks over the second woman's shoulder, with visible blond curls. The room resembles a rustic interior with wooden beams and assorted items such as a large jug and a basket of sticks or flowers. A loft area can be seen at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Portrait d'une jeune princesse
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a painted portrait format. She is positioned slightly sideways, facing the viewer with her head turned towards the painter. Her facial features include a fair complexion, round cheeks, and a subtle smile. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo adorned with small flowers. She is wearing a pale dress with a pink ribbon tied around the neckline, and a softly draped shawl over her shoulders. In her hands, she holds a circular framed miniature portrait and a garland of red flowers. The background features intricate details of a garden setting, including an ornate fountain decorated with greenery and tall trees.

artworks.title: Projet d'un monument a ériger pour le roi
artworks.description: This is a painting of a grand monument in a historical town square. The artwork depicts a large stone pedestal with bronze statues mounted on top. The central figures atop the pedestal include two standing men in historical attire, seemingly engaged in conversation, with one of them gesturing towards the other. At the base, a seated female figure holding a book emanates a sense of wisdom and contemplation. The foreground shows a bustling scene with elegantly dressed figures and a running dog. The background features classical architectural buildings. The sky above is vast and cloudy. This is in the style of an 18th-century European artist, capturing the grandeur and tradition of the depicted era.

artworks.title: Offrande à l'amour
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet after Jean Jacques Lagrenée II
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral scene with a woman kneeling on grass, holding a basket of flowers near a cherubic statue on a stone pedestal. Lush trees cover the background, and the brushstrokes emphasize movement in the woman's clothing and the foliage. The color palette is soft with greens, earth tones, and hints of pink and blue. Two figures are visible in the distance, among hills under a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Les trois graces
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet after Giovanni Antonio Pellegrini
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.description: Three nude women are standing closely together. The woman on the left faces slightly to the right, the middle woman has her back to the viewer, and the woman on the right is facing forward, looking towards the left. The woman on the left has blonde hair styled in an updo with loose curls. The middle woman has brown hair styled in a bun, and the woman on the right has long, curly blonde hair. Their facial features are serene. The woman on the left holds a bouquet of flowers in her right hand, and the woman on the right holds a similar bundle of flowers in her left hand. The background shows a landscape with hills, vegetation, and a blue sky.

artworks.title: La toilette de Venus
artworks.medium: wash manner, printed in blue, red, carmine, yellow, and black inks
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 49.3 x 38.6 cm (19 7/16 x 15 3/16 in.)
overall (outer framing line): 37.3 x 29.2 cm (14 11/16 x 11 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a luxurious chair or bed. She is in a relaxed position with her body slightly turned to the side. Her face is visible, with symmetrical features, and her hair is styled elegantly, falling softly around her shoulders. The woman is draped in silky fabric. Three cherubic figures are around her, with one playing with her hair. The woman is wearing a bracelet and holding a small cosmetic container. The background has a large green drape, an architectural element like a column, and decorative elements like flowers.

artworks.title: Venus en reflection
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclining, leaning on her right arm with her left hand resting on her abdomen. She has delicate facial features with closed eyes and her hair styled up with a blue ribbon. She is draped in a light garment, leaving her upper body exposed and her lower body covered with a floral garland and fabric. Nearby, there is a blue cushion with white stripes and a light-blue cloth. A child is seated by her feet arranging pink flowers in a basket. In the background, a cherub peeks out from behind the clouds. The setting features rich, red drapery and clouds transitioning into a light blue sky.

artworks.title: Venus desarmant l'amour
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person on a cushioned surface with blue drapery in the background. The person has light curly hair and delicate features, wearing a yellow draped fabric. An additional child-like figure is also present, interacting closely with the person. One hand of the adult figure holds a slender object, and white birds are nearby with a bouquet of flowers. In the background, there is ornate furniture and an oval frame.

artworks.title: Modeles de coiffures
artworks.description: The image shows five oval portraits of women from the chest up, each with elaborate hair and headwear styles. The women have different head positions: one frontal view, two in profile to the right, one at a three-quarter angle looking left, and a small center portrait in profile facing left. Each woman has distinct facial features, with soft, rounded cheeks, small mouths, and delicate noses. Their hairstyles are voluminous with intricate curls, adorned with ribbons, flowers, or hats. The women wear high-necked garments with frilled collars or shawls and rich fabric textures. Accessories like ribbons, floral decorations, and hats with feathers enhance their elegance. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with no additional elements, focusing solely on historical fashion.

artworks.title: Les heures du jour
artworks.description: The image features four circular illustrations, each showing a woman in a different setting. In the top left circle, a woman is sitting on an outdoor bench with a parasol. In the top right circle, two women are seated at a table. The bottom left circle shows a woman lounging on a chaise, and the bottom right circle depicts a woman at a writing desk. Each illustration is detailed with a focus on fashion, posture, and surroundings.

artworks.title: Le Bain
artworks.description: The image depicts two women in a room. One woman is seated, partly nude, on an elaborate chair with a cloth covering her lower body. Her hair is styled up with a headdress. The other woman, standing beside her, wears a long red and white dress with puffed sleeves and has her hair styled up with a headpiece. The room is lavishly decorated with a green canopy, patterned walls, a bench with a red draped garment, and a pair of red shoes on the floor. The period design of the room features curved lines and decorative details.

artworks.title: La Toilette
artworks.description: The image shows two women in an indoor setting. One woman is fully naked except for a decorative hat with flowers. The other woman, partially visible from the side, is helping the standing woman. The room contains a mirror, a plush chair with fabric, a side table with a vase of flowers, a clock, and candles. The wall has red-patterned wallpaper and an oval portrait of a man. There is a small fire and an ornate sconce.

artworks.title: Marie-Antoinette, Dauphine
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person displayed from the mid-torso up. The individual faces slightly to the left, with their gaze forward. They have a pale complexion, delicate facial features, and powdered hair styled pulled back. The person wears a garment with a red fur-trimmed collar and a light blue bow at the neckline. No jewelry is visible. The background features an oval frame with decorative leaf motifs on a dark, textured backdrop. An inscription below the oval states the name and title of the person depicted.

artworks.title: L'accident imprevu
artworks.description: The image shows two people, a woman and a young boy, depicted in full-body view. The woman is standing in profile, facing the boy, who is standing directly in front of her. The woman has her hair styled under a large bonnet and is wearing a long dress with long sleeves and a fitted bodice. The boy has short hair and is dressed in a coat with knee-length breeches and stockings, holding a hat in one hand. The room they occupy appears to be a bedroom with a high bed draped with a curtain in the background. There is a table with an iron on a piece of fabric and a chair nearby. The furniture in the room includes a dresser with an open drawer and a cabinet with open doors, revealing a few items on top, including a bust and a bowl. The setting has a window on the right side, allowing light into the room.

artworks.title: The Preparations for the Ballet
artworks.description: The image depicts an indoor scene with multiple individuals in a bustling room. The figures, both men and women, are engaged in various activities such as conversation, dressing, and grooming. The women wear elaborate 18th-century attire with voluminous skirts, bodices, and adorned hats. Some are brushing hair, adjusting clothing, or holding bouquets. The men help the women or adjust their own attire. Women have fashionable updo hairstyles, while men have more subdued styles, with one wearing a necktie. The room is well-lit with large windows and minimal furniture. The background shows a dark wall with hanging garments and a large door to another room. This scene captures a social moment of preparation and leisure, showcasing detailed fashion and lively interactions.

artworks.title: L'assemblee au concert
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene featuring individuals gathered for a musical concert. The drawing depicts an opulently decorated room with a domed ceiling adorned with floral designs and classical statues. On the left, three individuals are engaged in conversation, while on the right, musicians are seen preparing for a performance. In the center, an individual is seated at a piano-like instrument. The use of intricate lines and shading techniques highlights the details of the scene.
